Fig. 1.1's parallel caption shows the intended pattern — a named [1P] source for the mechanism and a separate "Ch 4, Table 4-2" pointer for the scenario geometry — so the compressed parenthetical mislabels the book's own scenario documentation as first-party vendor fact.
fix_instruction: Re-point the mechanism citation to the section that documents it (e.g. "§2.1 / Ch 3") or name a first-party source, and cite "Ch 4, Table 4-2" only for the canonical geometry the figure instantiates, with the matching [canonical scenario] tag.
